profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Calm, intelligent and alert, the Polish Tatra Sheepdog carries a long tradition of watching over flocks in the Podhale highlands. Its work centered on protecting livestock rather than moving sheep. At a postwar breed assessment in Zakopane, most of the roughly 120 dogs entered still worked with sheep, reflecting that close link to pastoral life.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A calm, watchful Polish livestock guardian whose Tatra heritage centers on protecting flocks rather than driving them.
